mapper.select: SELECT lot_no, item_cd, qty, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM lot WHERE wo_id = #{woId} ORDER BY lot_no

SELECT result_id, proc_cd, eqp_cd, lot_no, good_qty, defect_qty, defect_cd, to_char(work_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS work_date, shift_cd, to_char(reported_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reported_at FROM production_result WHERE wo_id = #{woId} ORDER BY result_id

INSERT INTO lot_seq AS s (plant_cd, work_date, last_seq) SELECT #{plantCd}, #{workDate}, COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(lot_no, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1 FROM lot WHERE lot_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%' ON CONFLICT (plant_cd, work_date) DO UPDATE SET last_seq = GREATEST(s.last_seq + 1, EXCLUDED.last_seq) RETURNING last_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lot (lot_no, plant_cd, wo_id, item_cd, qty) VALUES (#{lotNo}, #{plantCd}, #{woId}, #{itemCd}, #{qty})
mapper.select: INSERT INTO production_result (plant_cd, wo_id, proc_cd, eqp_cd, lot_no, good_qty, defect_qty, defect_cd, work_date, shift_cd, reported_at) VALUES (#{plantCd}, #{woId}, #{procCd}, #{eqpCd}, #{lotNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{goodQty}, #{defectQty}, #{defectCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workDate}, #{shiftCd}, #{reportedAt}) RETURNING result_id
